item.title: Synergy Marine Group assumes technical management of Yang Ming’s LNG dual-fuel newbuilds
item.description: Synergy Marine Group has taken over the technical management of two 15 500 TEU Class LNG dual-fuel container vessels newly delivered to Yang Ming Marine Transport Corp.

item.title: YPF, Eni, and XRG sign joint development agreement for Argentina LNG
item.description: YPF, Eni, and XRG, the foundational project partners, have signed a binding joint development agreement to advance Argentina LNG.

item.title: JERA announces close of Haynesville shale gas asset
item.description: JERA Co. Inc. has closed on its previously announced agreement with Williams and GEP Haynesville II, LLC to acquire 100% of their respective interests in the South Mansfield upstream asset located in the Haynesville Shale basin in western Louisiana.

item.title: North Macedonia to purchase US LNG
item.description: The US and North Macedonia have signed a framework agreement for the purchase of US LNG upon the completion of a new gas interconnector between North Macedonia and Greece.

item.title: Caturus and Aramco Trading sign 20-year LNG offtake agreement
item.description: Caturus has announced the signing of a sale and purchase agreement between Commonwealth LNG and Aramco Trading, a subsidiary of Saudi Aramco.

item.title: Navigator Midstream expands into natural gas infrastructure
item.description: Navigator has announced the expansion of its existing midstream platform with a dedicated natural gas infrastructure focus.

item.title: RDP closes financing documents for Buenaventura project
item.description: Following the closing of Regasificadora Del Pacifico S.A.S.’ financing documents on the Buenaventura project, EXMAR will be leasing and operating an FSU to the company for a period of five years.

item.title: GTT receives order for LNG carrier tank design
item.description: GTT has received an order from the Jiangnan shipyard for the tank design of four new LNG carriers on behalf of Shandong Marine Energy.

item.title: Naftogaz signs grant agreement with EBRD for imported gas
item.description: Naftogaz has signed a grant agreement with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development for €85 million which will be directed toward financing the purchase of imported natural gas.

item.title: Volvo Trucks reaches LNG-powered milestone
item.description: Volvo Trucks has delivered more than 10 000 LNG-powered trucks globally since it was introduced in 2018.
